items.question: What is Taskify?
items.answer: Taskify is a task and project management app created by Shiva Bhusal. It brings projects, task assignments, priorities, due dates and progress updates together for individuals and teams.

items.question: Can my team use the Taskify app?
items.answer: Yes. Create a team, invite members and share projects. Assign work to the right people, discuss it with comments and files, and follow each task from to-do to completion.

link.label: Learn how to set up your first project

items.question: Which platforms does Taskify support?
items.answer: The Taskify app is built for Android and iOS. Official Google Play and App Store links will be added to this website as they go live.

items.question: Is Taskify Web available in a browser?
items.answer: Taskify Web, the browser app, is planned. For now, Taskify supports Android and iOS. This is the official Taskify website for product information, setup guides and support. When browser access launches, it will be linked from this website.

items.question: How do I get started with Taskify?
items.answer: Create an account, verify your email, set up a project and add your team. Then create tasks with owners, priorities and due dates. Our getting-started guide walks through the workflow.

items.question: Who created Taskify?
items.answer: Taskify is designed and built by Shiva Bhusal, including the mobile app, backend and this marketing website.
